design_summary: Defect-fixing efforts across two waves that hardened the boss-fight loop, combat input, multiplayer death/revive handling, and the title-screen profile/join flow. Most fixes traced to collision-layer and Variant type-inference root causes and landed in the pre-v0.10.0 stabilization push of mid-March 2026.

epics.title: Bug Fixes
epics.summary: First wave of defect fixes covering boss arena escape, crash/Variant inference errors, pause menu control, broken attack input, boss damage and floor-clipping, all-players-dead soft-lock, melee ground hits, and the title-screen START button. All stories shipped during the mid-March 2026 stabilization before v0.10.0 tagging began.

stories.title: Boss Arena Escape
stories.summary: Confined the boss arena with walls/ceiling and added a kill zone below the floor that respawns players who fall.

tasks.title: Add walls/ceiling to boss arena so players can't jump out
Add kill zone below arena floor (respawn player if they fall)

stories.title: Crash Fixes
stories.summary: Audited scripts for Variant type-inference crashes, tested all scene transitions, and resolved call_deferred issues in physics callbacks. Multiple Variant inference and post-boss-defeat crash fixes landed 2026-03-14.

tasks.title: Audit all scripts for Variant type inference errors (sign(), etc.)
Test all scene transitions (title→overworld→tower→boss→overworld)
Fix any remaining call_deferred issues during physics callbacks

stories.title: Pause Menu
stories.summary: Restricted pause-menu control to the player who pressed START, added navigation cooldown, and split Quit-to-title from Quit Game.

tasks.title: Only the player who pressed START controls the menu
Add navigation cooldown to prevent too-fast scrolling
Quit goes to title screen first, separate "Quit Game" exits entirely

stories.title: Attack Button Not Working
stories.summary: Fixed the attack button doing nothing for any class — the charge system was intercepting every press on the first frame. Charge now only activates after a 0.3s hold so quick taps fire normal attacks (commit 2026-03-14: charge system was eating all taps).

tasks.title: BUG: Square button (attack) does nothing for any class — charge system intercepted every press; fix: charge only after 0.3s hold

stories.title: Boss Damage Bug
stories.summary: Players could not damage the Giant Muffin because bosses had no collision_layer set (defaulted to world) and were invisible to attack masks. Fix put all 4 bosses on collision_layer 8 and in the enemies/bosses groups (commit 2026-03-14: bosses now on collision layer 8).

tasks.title: BUG: Players cannot damage the final boss (Giant Muffin) - attacks don't register
Investigate boss collision layers vs player attack area masks
Verify boss is in "enemies"/"bosses" group and take_damage is callable

stories.title: Soft-Lock When All Players Die
stories.summary: Fixed the soft-lock when all players died with no revive path; PlayerManager now emits all_players_dead and GameManager shows an overlay then auto-restarts the scene with players revived (commit 2026-03-14: auto restart).

tasks.title: BUG: Game soft-locks when all players die (no revive possible) — fix: all_players_dead signal + auto-restart with revive

stories.title: Melee Ground Attack Not Hitting
stories.summary: Fixed melee ground attacks not registering (monitoring and get_overlapping_bodies on the same frame) by waiting one physics frame, then added arcing slash VFX and blood particles (commits 2026-03-14: fix melee attack + arc VFX and blood particles).

tasks.title: BUG: Melee attack on ground doesn't hit enemies — wait one physics frame after enabling monitoring
Replace melee swing VFX with large arcing slash + silver/grey/yellow/white particles
Blood particles on enemy hit (3 squirts, arc upward, land on surfaces, drip down)

stories.title: Boss Falls Through Floor
stories.summary: Fixed the Giant Muffin falling through the arena floor — summoned minions on collision_layer 1 pushed the boss through; minions now use layer 8 plus a safety teleport when the boss drops below the arena (commit 2026-03-16: fix stuck pseudo-enemy squares in boss arenas).

tasks.title: BUG: Giant Muffin falls through arena floor — minions moved to collision_layer 8 + safety teleport

stories.title: Title Screen START Button Ignored
stories.summary: Fixed START doing nothing on fresh launch with no players — name-entry/camera setup only ran on return-from-game, so no profile bound. Fix calls _setup_camera() and _setup_name_entry() unconditionally in _ready() (commit 2026-03-16: fix 3 title screen bugs incl. START button).

tasks.title: BUG: Pressing START on title screen with no players does nothing — call setup unconditionally in _ready()

epics.title: Bug Fixes - Wave 2
epics.summary: Second wave focused on the profile and join flow: requiring profile selection before joining, persisting profiles to JSON in user://, and adding a ProfileManager autoload for device-profile mapping. Landed mid-March 2026 (commits 2026-03-14: persistent profiles saved to disk; players must always select profile on title screen).

stories.title: Profile & Join Fixes
stories.summary: Required profile selection before joining, added cross-session profile persistence in user://, and introduced a ProfileManager autoload for device-profile mapping.

tasks.title: Profile selection required before joining game
Profile persistence across sessions (JSON in user://)
ProfileManager autoload handles device-profile mapping
